question: Which of the following statements about belt drive systems is false?

options.A: Linear speed on a point of each pulley will be the same as the linear speed of the belt
options.B: Belt driver pulleys move follower pulleys by means of frictional force between the belt and the pulleys
options.C: Rotational speed will be equal if the pulley diameters are equal
options.D: A belt system is 100% efficient if there is no slippage
options.E: Tension in the bottom belt is always double that in the top belt

explanation: Tension values depend on the tight and slack sides of the operating drive rather than a fixed rule about top and bottom positions [Mechanical Drives].

question: Which statement concerning belt trains is false?

options.A: Belt trains transmit less power than gear trains of comparable size
options.B: Belt trains are used to change power transmissions of belts
options.C: Trains are connected by a single belt
options.D: Belt trains are used to change speeds of pulleys
options.E: Pulleys in a train all rotate in the same direction

explanation: Belt trains typically involve multiple pulleys and individual belts connected in series, rather than a single continuous belt spanning an entire train [Mechanical Drives].

question: Idlers gears:

options.B: Cannot be larger than the driven gear
options.C: Affect the speed of the driven gear
options.D: Are not regarded as intermediate gears

explanation: Idler gears are primarily inserted between driver and driven gears to reverse the rotational direction of the follower [Mechanical Drives].

question: Which of following statements about idler gears is true?

options.C: Changes the r/min of the driven gear

explanation: The inclusion of an idler gear reverses the rotational direction of the driven gear relative to the driver gear [Mechanical Drives].

question: In a belt drive system if the driver is smaller than the follower, the:

options.A: Follower will turn faster than the driver
options.B: Both follower and driver will turn at the same speed
options.C: Follower will turn at the same speed as the driver
options.D: Follower will turn slower than the driver
options.E: Driver will turn slower than the follower

explanation: A smaller driver pulley driving a larger follower pulley results in a speed reduction, meaning the follower turns slower [Mechanical Drives].

question: A pulley of diameter 2.6 m rotates at 107 r/min and drives a follower pulley at 259 r/min. What is the diameter of the following pulley?
explanation: Using $D_1 N_1 = D_2 N_2$: $(2.6 \times 107) / 259 = 1.074\text{ m} \approx 1.07\text{ m}$ [Mechanical Drives].

question: The input to a 93.33% efficient belt drive system is 75 kW. What is the output?
explanation: Output = Input $\times$ Efficiency = $75\text{ kW} \times 0.9333 = 70\text{ kW}$ [Mechanical Drives].

question: A 28-tooth gear turns at 100 rpm and drives a 112-tooth gear. What is the speed of the follower gear?
explanation: Using $T_1 N_1 = T_2 N_2$: $(28 \times 100) / 112 = 25\text{ rpm}$ [Mechanical Drives].

question: A pulley with a diameter of 50 cm is driven at 960 r/min. What will be the linear speed in m/s of a point on the rim of the pulley?
An idler gear ________ the speed of the gear train.
explanation: An idler gear changes rotational direction and spans distance, but does not alter the overall speed ratio between the driver and driven gears [Mechanical Drives].

question: The clearance that is necessary between teeth that have to mesh is called:
explanation: Backlash is the clearance or spacing between mating gear teeth to prevent binding and ensure smooth operation [Mechanical Drives].

question: A gear wheel with 85 teeth rotates at 6 500 r/min and drives another gear at 9 866 r/min. How many teeth does the driven gear have?
explanation: Using $T_1 N_1 = T_2 N_2$: $(85 \times 6500) / 9866 = 552500 / 9866 = 56$ teeth [Mechanical Drives].

question: The tensions in the tight and slack side of a belt are 14 000 N and 900 N respectively. If the power transmission is 655 kW what is the speed of the belt if there is no slippage?
explanation: Power $P = (T_1 - T_2) \cdot v \implies v = 655,000\text{ W} / (14,000 - 900)\text{ N} = 50\text{ m/s}$ [Mechanical Drives].

question: If two pulleys of different diameters are connected by a belt, the larger diameter pulley will turn _____ the smaller diameter pulley.
explanation: Larger pulleys rotate at lower speeds compared to smaller pulleys in a connected belt drive system [Mechanical Drives].

question: A chain drive system has a driver sprocket of 300 mm diameter and a driven sprocket of 1 000 mm diameter. If the driven shaft rotates at 276 rpm what will be the speed of the driving shaft?
explanation: Using $D_1 N_1 = D_2 N_2$: $(1000 \times 276) / 300 = 920\text{ rpm}$ [Mechanical Drives].
